children.description: One tile per child. Photos, avatars, icons, or any small content.

columns.description: Fixed column count. Leave it out to fit as many columns as minTileSize allows.

minTileSize.description: Smallest tile width in px when columns is not set.

radius.description: Reach of the well in px.

onPulse.description: Called when a click or key sends a shockwave, with its origin in px from the top left of the grid.
